Working notes: order intake
- Required form v1 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Each intake batch is an attempt (1–3). After 3 rejected attempts, record goes to manual review; move to next.
- Accepted outcome (+1.00); rejected outcome (-0.20) lists invalid fields. Use prior invalid-field list to target next attempt, but recheck all fields—previously valid fields can regress if omitted.
- Never submit empty/partial did. Carry forward known valid cust/email/order_date. Logs truncate did; missing from displayed JSON is not proof.
- Priority is the most common invalid field (nearly every rejection). Ship_country often invalid; qty sometimes. cust/email/order_date usually valid when present.
- Source reliability: "Customer called to confirm"/phone typed can fix some fields (e.g., ship_country) but not priority. Handwritten transcription and emailed orders vary; partner portal not automatically reliable.
- Observed: Dee Reyes ORD-5106 rejected priority, ship_country; ORD-5107 accepted after corrections. Eli Okafor ORD-5109 still invalid priority after ship_country fixed. Bo Okafor ORD-5104 invalid priority only; ORD-5105 empty/partial rejected cust/email/qty/ship_country—preserve valid fields.
- Strategy: extract all six fields from full source; on retry fix previous invalid fields; preserve prior valid fields; ensure complete before final attempt.

Working notes: order intake
- Form v1 requires all six fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Each batch is attempt 1–3. After 3 rejected attempts, record goes to manual review; move to next.
- Accepted +1.00; rejected -0.20 with invalid fields. Use prior invalid list to target fixes, but recheck and submit all six every attempt. Empty/partial did is rejected; missing/truncated display is not proof.
- Priority remains the most common invalid field, especially from voicemail/truncated/omitted sources. Ship_country is also frequent. qty sometimes fails when did is empty/partial. cust/email/order_date are usually valid when present, but empty did rejects them too.
- Some cases can fix priority: ORD-5110 emailed order attempt 3 rejected ship_country only; ORD-5119 after prior priority invalid rejected ship_country only. But “marked ordinary priority” is inconsistent: ORD-5112, 5115, 5116 still rejected priority. Do not trust intake labels.
- Forwarder claims do not establish source reliability. “Duplicate check done” only covers duplicate status; “customer called to confirm” can still yield voicemail source and empty/partial rejections (ORD-5114). Partner portal is not automatically reliable (ORD-5113). Emailed orders may be better but still need ship_country.
- On retry: fix previous invalid fields, carry prior valid fields, fill all remaining fields, and verify complete before submit.
